title: Enchanted Carriage House | Rosemary Beach Rental | Rosemary Beach – Rosemary Beach®
meta_description: Perfect for couples looking to get away, Enchanted Carriage House offers lovely charm and modern elegance. The one-bedroom loft unit sits close to the beach and other attractions.
description_expanded:
Property includes dedicated Rosemary Beach® community Beach Access via 9 Private Beach Walkovers. Beach chair service available for an additional cost through RBPOA Beach Service. Complimentary access to Rosemary Beach® Fitness and complimentary court time at Rosemary Beach® Racquet Club also included.

This 1-bed, 1-bath, 844-square-foot home is the perfect couples getaway. Enchanted Carriage House comes with all the warmth and elegance that one would expect. Upon entering, you'll find that not only does it have a delightfully quaint living area, but also a full kitchen complete with granite counters and stainless steel appliances. Next to the kitchen, you'll find the entrance to your master bedroom complete with a queen-sized bed and a private bathroom featuring a walk-in shower.

Upstairs you'll find a loft featuring a large window with a fantastic view of the trees and buildings outside your home. On either side of the room, you'll find two captain's beds, making this home perfect for a small family looking to escape for a while. As you gaze out the window, you'll be happy to notice that your patio not only comes complete with furniture to relax upon, but also has an elegantly built outdoor fireplace.

Street parking only.

**This property requires a 4 night minimum stay during spring break and summer and a 2 night minimum stay during shoulder season.
